value.title: Digimon Adventure: Our War Game!
value.synopsis: A year after the events of the first season, a virus Digimon called Diaboromon appears and starts attacking the Internet. The DigiDestined unites once more in order to prevent him from destroying every communications network on the planet.

value.title: Digimon Adventure: Last Evolution Kizuna
value.synopsis: The team discovers that when they grow up, their relationship with their Digimon will come closer to an end. They realize that the more they fight, the faster their bond breaks and the time to choose is approaching fast.
